candidates.title: OPTIMUS PRIME Challenge Brings Winning Students to NASA Goddard
candidates.description: From June 28 through 30, 2016, the OPTIMUS PRIME Spinoff Promotion and Research Challenge (OPSPARC) gave the contest’s winning students the opportunity to explore NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland.
